title: notholaena hirta
intro: Notholaena hirta, commonly known as Hair Fern or Soft Shield Fern, is a species of fern native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties that aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Notholaena hirta include its use as an anti-spasmodic and anti-asthmatic agent, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Notholaena hirta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
